arabic text: Sajjad Ke Khaimon Ka Dhuwan Dekh Raha Hun\nMei Parda-e-Ghaibat Se Samaa Dekh Raha Hun
english translation text: The smoke rising from Sajjad's tents I behold\nFrom behind the veil of occultation, I behold this scene

arabic text: Zainab Chali Jis Aag Mei Aabid Ko Bachaane\nUss aag Mei Pairon Ke Nishaan Dekh Raha Hun\nMei Parda-e-Ghaibat Se Samaa Dekh Raha Hun
english translation text: The fire through which Zainab walked to save Abid\nIn that fire, the marks of her feet I behold\nFrom behind the veil of occultation, I behold this scene

arabic text: Jis Sar Pe Sajaa Karti Thi Dastaare-Muhammad\nUss Sar Ko Sare Noke Sinaa Dekh Raha Hun\nMain Parda-e-Ghaibat Se Samaa Dekh Raha Hun
english translation text: The head once crowned by Muhammad's turban\nThat very head upon the tip of a spear I behold\nFrom behind the veil of occultation, I behold this scene

arabic text: Bas Teer Hai Chalne Ko Ab Asghar Ke Gale Par\nZaalim Ki Mei Khamraa Kamaa Dekh Raha Hun\nMei Parda-e-Ghaibat Se Samaa Dekh Raha Hun
english translation text: The arrow is now about to strike Asghar's throat\nThe oppressor's drawn bow I behold\nFrom behind the veil of occultation, I behold this scene

arabic text: Jis Rukh Ke Liye Karte The Bosse Shahe Waala\nUss Rukh Pe Tamaachon Ke Nishaa(n) Dekh Raha Hun\nMei Parda-e-Ghaibat Se Samaa Dekh Raha Hun
english translation text: The face that the exalted King used to kiss\nUpon that face, the marks of slaps I behold\nFrom behind the veil of occultation, I behold this scene

arabic text: Maqtal Mei Kahaan Saani-e-Zehra Ki Ridaa Hai\nAbbas Ke Baazu Hai Kahaan Dekh Raha Hun\nMei Parda-e-Ghaibat Se Samaa Dekh Raha Hun
english translation text: Where in the battlefield is the veil of the second Zahra?\nWhere are Abbas's arms? I search and behold\nFrom behind the veil of occultation, I behold this scene

arabic text: Aaye Na Watan Laut Ke Phir Aun-o-Muhammad\nUjraa Huwa Zainab Ka Makaa(n) Dekh Raha Hun\nMei Parda-e-Ghaibat Se Samaa Dekh Raha Hun
english translation text: Aun and Muhammad never returned to their homeland\nZainab's ruined home I behold\nFrom behind the veil of occultation, I behold this scene

arabic text: Maa Baap Behen Bhaayi Phuphi Aur Aizzah\nIk Teer Mei Kitno Ki Mei Jaan Dekh Raha Hun\nMei Parda-e-Ghaibat Se Samaa Dekh Raha Hun
english translation text: Mother, father, sister, brother, aunt and all relatives\nWithin a single arrow, how many lives I behold\nFrom behind the veil of occultation, I behold this scene

arabic text:
("Gohar" Hai Jahaa(n) Dafn Saqeefa Ki Shaheeda) 
Uss Qabr Ko Benaamo Nishaan Dekh Raha Hun
Mei Parda-e-Ghaibat Se Samaa Dekh Raha Hun
Anaa Yabna-Zahra, Anaa Yabna-Zahra, Anaa Yabna-Zahra
english translation text:
"Gohar", where the martyr of Saqifa lies buried 
That grave without a name or sign I behold
From behind the veil of occultation, I behold this scene
I am the son of Zahra, I am the son of Zahra, I am the son of Zahra
